inputText: This is Shin — SHEEN. Sound: SH as in ship (with the dot on the right). Shape hook: three candle flames on one holder. Tip: Three upward branches joining at bottom; no other letter has this clear triple crown; do not mix it up with Ayin, Tsadi.
